content: Yuusufa toksiɗ heeƴ ciŋ Firawnaana
Wa degga kiis kanak, Firawnaana, buuraŋ Misra heeƴca. Ŋ heeƴiŋ ɗe, an a nikee ŋ sero kala na woyse Niil.
A hotta inoh moɗiɗ yasna-kanak, kapiɗ, pulohha nga, ca ñameeɗa ŋ paangfa ŋ sereenda.
A hotissa ŋak moɗaaɗi'iɗ yasna-kanak nammba puloh ŋ kala, ca nikka na ca.
Ŋak ca ñammba inoh ca kapiɗ ca. Ndeem, Firawnaana yunukka.
A neehissa, a heeƴissa mbong yasna-kanak moɗiɗ, ɓiɗsiɗ ŋ mbaang yino.
Furus yasna-kanak ca fu inah ne a mbooyooni oñiɗ ca, ɓiɗissa ŋ serooca ;
furus ca onnda mbong ca yasna-kanak ca moɗiɗ ca. Firawnaana yunukka, a inahha ne a heeƴ heeƴ.
Wa Kooh wiis na ɓaaɓa, Firawnaana feyuusa, a cohɗohha naah ca na riifiɗ haf caŋ Misra jen, a naandsukka ɓa heeƴ caŋ ɗe, waaye ali ɓo' nga ɓa minɗi ɗe ca toksiɗ.
Ƴaara adgohee ɓa meeɗ taambkoh anaah caŋ Firawnaana woosa ɗe ne : « Mi deey, ŋ hey naandsohe tooñiŋ ngo woti.
Firawna ayrukeen mi na ƴaara adgohee utoh mbuuruuci po a rannga ɓoo ŋ kasooniŋ dagi adgoh ɓi na niiɗe kahan ce.
Ɓoo heeƴandoosa, te heeƴ nu nga ɗah raakeen ini wa tokis.
Komaaki fiir Heber nikeen na ɓoo ŋ ɗooƴ kasoona, a ñaamiŋ dagi adgoh ɓi na niiɗe kahan buur. Ɓoo naandsukka ɗe yaa nu nga ɗah ini fu heeƴ, a yi toksiɗ ɓoo ca mbaɗi.
Te findi a toksoh ca, ca raakoh ɗaa ; ŋ doknuusa ŋ pangkiŋ ngo, ƴaara tas keɗuusa ŋ kidig. »
Firawnaana woosa ne ɓa kaɗaat ɓa haya na ɗe. Ɓa arra kaɗ ŋ kasoona, ɓa puliɗta ɗe, a nenukka, a ɓekukka kulɓa wiiriis, ɓa ɓayya ɗe ŋ Firawnaana.
Firawnaana woosa Yuusufa ne : « Ŋ heeƴ heeƴ, te ali ɓo' minɗi wa tokis, waaye ŋ kerah ne fu miniɗ tokis heeƴ nu fu naandsuku ɗah. »
Yuusufa woosa ɗe ne : « A ñam haa, waaye a Kooh na hee eɗohe toksi na hee ɗa doye. »
Firawnaana woosa Yuusufa ne : « Ŋ heeƴiŋ ngo, ŋ nikee ŋ sero Niil,
ŋ hotta inoh moɗiɗ yasna-kanak, kapiɗ, pulohha nga, ca ñameeɗa ŋ paangfa ŋ sereenda.
Ŋak yasna-kanak moɗaaɗi'oh na moɗaaɗi'oh nammba puloh nga, ŋ moosɗi hotoh mand ɗaa moɗaaɗi ŋ Misra.
Ca ñammba inoh ca koc, ceɗ ca yasna-kanak ca kapiɗ ca nikka ŋ rook ciŋ ca. Te ɓo' minɗi wa hot nga ca sagu risa ca risee ŋak ; ndeem ŋ yunukka.
Ŋ heeƴissa mbong yasna-kanak moɗiɗ, ɓiɗissa ŋ mbaang yino.
Furus yasna-kanak moɗaaɗi, ca fu inah ne a mbooyooni oñiɗ ca, ɓiɗissa ŋ serooca.
Furus ca onnda mbong ca yasna-kanak ca. Ŋ naandsukiɗ ca naah ci waaye ali ɓo' nga ɓa minɗi so ca toksiɗ. »
Yuusufa woosa Firawnaana ne : « Heeƴ ciŋ ɗa tokis in yino ; Kooh na teeɓee ɗa ini a na hee tume.
Inoh ci yasna-kanak ci kapiɗ ci ca kiis yasna-kanak findi mbong ci yasna-kanak ci ; kon wa heeƴ yino.
Ŋak ci yasna-kanak ci moɗaaɗiici, ca kiis yasna-kanak findi furus ci yasna-kanak ci mbooyooni oñiɗ ; ca nikan kiis aɗ yasna-kanak.
Weɗ ini ŋ woo ɗa rek Firawna, Kooh na teeɓee ɗa ini a na hee tume.
Kiis ci yasna-kanak ci na haye, ca na hee nike kiis laaɓɗuk ngaŋ Misra jen.
Kiis yasna-kanak hey taambe nga ca, ci fu inah ne ca na hee nike kiis aɗ, ca hey tahe po kiis ciŋ laaɓɗi alu te ca hey yahrohe kur ki.
Ca hey miske lool, po ɓooɓi alkoh ne kur ki laaɓɗeen.
Ini tah fu heeƴca ca waas kanak Firawna, weɗ ne Kooh tufkiɗ ne ca hey raake, te a hey ca raakɗe findi wa uup gaawoh.
Ɗiski wa nik ndii Firawna, waaka ɓo' ñaañiɗ, heɗ liiɓohaaɗ moɗiɗ, yi fu na hee tufkiɗe, a adgoh kur ki.
Fu nam waak ɓi kilifa ɓi fu inah ne, ɓa hey ɓaye ŋ in ci na hee nguɗse ŋ kur ki, yatuus nu nik ɗah, yinooriŋ wa, ŋ kiis ciŋ laaɓɗi jen.
Ŋ kiis ciŋ laaɓɗi na haye, ɓa nangɗoh pesoha ŋ kur ci yakak ci, fu deg ca yaah.
Misra hey ɗaakke po kiis ci yasna-kanak ciŋ aɗi hay ɗah, ca telan ɓi kur ki raakiɗ pesoha po ɓa muc ŋ aɗi. »
Yuusufa adgohiɗ Misra
Wa Yuusufa woo po a ƴutta, Firawnaana na dag caŋ ɗe jen hunnda ŋ woo kaŋ ɗe.
Firawnaana woosa ɓa ne : « Ƴaari Fuuɗsiŋ Kooh
nik ŋ ɗooƴ ce yii, andi ɓoo minisiɗ raak mand na ɗe ? »
A woosa Yuusufa ne : « Nik ne Kooh teeɓiɗ ɗa in cii jen ɗah, ali ɓo' minɗi mand na ɗa ; fu ñaañiɗ, fu heɗ haf,
mbaa ɗah, ŋ hey ɗa adgiɗe, ɓi kur ki jen taambee ŋ woo kiŋ ɗa ; a tiikiŋ buuri ŋ nikoh dong weɗ ŋ uupohan ɗa.
Mbaa, ŋ degiɗ Misra jen ŋ yaah ciŋ ɗa. »
Firawnaana nihissa jaarndaŋ ɗe inhisohaana, a ɓekiɗta Yuusufa wa na kulɓa mbaseñ, a nammba ɗe tokiɗ ceen urus ŋ mbooh.
A rapiɗta ɗe ŋ wotiira uup baah ɗal waŋ ɗe ɗah. Ɓi ɓo' adugka, ɓa weeɗa ne : « Haaƴɗukaat. » Firawnaana degoh Misra jen ɗaa ŋ yaah Yuusufa.
Firawnaana woosa Yuusufa ne : « Ñam Firawnaani, waaye ali ɓo' tumanɗi in ŋ Misra jen, te fu hunɗi nga. »
Firawnaana feriɗta Yuusufa tiik, Safnat-Peneya ; a onnda ɗe ɓitiɓ teeku Asnat, kuɓu Potifera, ɓoyi na seeƴkiɗohe ŋ kur-taaha na woyse On. Yuusufa taambohha nga, a adgohha Misra jen.
Wa Yuusufa na ɓayse ŋ ɗiskaŋ Firawnaana, buuraŋ Misra, tel ɗe raak kiis ndaŋkiyaah-kaahay (30). A kurkohha ŋ ndeem, ne a taambiɗ Misra jen.
Wa kiis ca yasna-kanak caŋ laaɓɗa hay, kur ka laaɓiɗta keeh-keeh.
Yuusufa nangɗohha pesohaaca a ɓayoh ŋ kiis ca yasna-kanak caŋ laaɓɗa, a ɗaakka ca ŋ kur-taah ca ; waa nu nga ɗa, ini nguɗohu ŋ ɗisik ci wila ɗaakuusa nga.
Yuusufa nangɗohha bele po ca laayya findi merhey mi ŋ yaah-cookmi. Kaɗta po ɓa inhisɗi findi ca hend, ɓa faɗta ɓeesa.
Bala kiis caŋ aɗa hayan ɗah, Asnat kuɓu Potifera seeƴkiɗohaŋ kur ka na woyse On, raakeen kuɓu ƴaar kanak na Yuusufa.
A teekka saawiŋ ɗe Manasse (tah alkoh) laam a woo ne : « Kooh oniɗ to ini na hee so tahe alkoh miskiɗ ciŋ ngo po caŋ kahan baab ɓoo sah. »
A teekka taambɗoha Efrayim (ɓasil) laam a woo ne : « Kooh tumiɗ to ɓasil ŋ kur ki ŋ torhiɗohu. »
Wa kiis ca yasna-kanak caŋ laaɓɗa nikee ŋ Misra coot,
caŋ aɗa hayya findi Yuusufa woyohee wa. Kur ci jen nikka ŋ aɗ waaye pesoha raakeen ŋ Misra.
Wa aɗa ree nga ɓi kur ka, ɓa kaɗta ŋ Firawnaana, ɓa meekseeɗa ɗe ñamaah. A woosa ɓa jen ne : « Kaɗaat ŋ Yuusufa, in nu a woo ɗu ɗah, ɗu tum ineem. »
Misra jen nikka ŋ aɗ. Yuusufa rangissa in ca ɓa ɗaakkohe, a tooneeɗa bele laam aɗa miskeen lool.
Ɓi ɓo' puloheeɗa ŋ kur ci wil Misra jen, ɓa heeɗa rome bele ŋ Yuusufa, laam, aɗa miskeen ŋ kehƴi jen.

footnotes.text: Fuuɗsiŋ Kooh : ngaŋ heber na gerek, feruuɗ ci na hotkeeɗi, na puuɗsi, na liiɓ ɓo', ceɗ ɓaah tiik. Ŋ heber wa nikka "ruwah", ŋ gerek, wa nikka "pnewma". Kon, ɓa woo "ruwahiŋ Kooh wala pnewmaaniŋ Kooh ɗah, wa yooɓɗi tokis. A mand na liiɓi nik ŋ ɗooƴ Kooh, a mand na in ci na hotkeeɗi. Ngaŋ teerndiŋ Tum ci 2:2-4"pnewmaaniŋ" Kooh hayiɗ findi puuɗsi. A yi ɓoo teek "Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani" wala "Fuuɗsiŋ Kooh" ŋ saafi-saafi, waaye in ci kaahay ceem jen, ca ɗii ŋ ɗooƴi.
